title: Contracted Storage Lot Rate Card for Repossession and Collateral Recovery
content:
A vehicle held for a Repossession and Collateral Recovery case sits at a contracted storage lot, and the lot's storage terms follow the vehicle's collateral class.

| Collateral class | Storage per chargeable day (USD) | Calendar days after the recovery date not charged | Maximum storage days charged on one case |
|---|---|---|---|
| Recovery Class 1 Passenger Car | 25.00 | 2 | 45 |
| Recovery Class 2 Minivan and Crossover | 30.00 | 2 | 45 |
| Recovery Class 3 Sport Utility Vehicle | 30.00 | 2 | 45 |
| Recovery Class 4 Light-Duty Pickup | 35.00 | 2 | 45 |
| Recovery Class 5 Heavy-Duty Pickup | 45.00 | 2 | 45 |
| Recovery Class 6 Full-Size Van | 50.00 | 2 | 45 |

Column meanings, as the rate card defines them:

- **Storage per chargeable day** — storage per chargeable day at the contracted lot, in US dollars.
- **Days not charged** — calendar days after the recovery date not charged for storage (the class free days).
- **Maximum days charged** — maximum storage days charged on one case.

## Points of reading

- The day fee climbs with the class, from 25.00 for a passenger car to 50.00 for a full-size van; the free days and the maximum are the same in every class.
- The maximum is a count of days, not an amount: no case is charged storage for more than 45 days at its class fee, whatever the length of the hold.
- Illustration with hypothetical figures: for a Recovery Class 2 Minivan and Crossover case the class figures are 30.00 a day, 2 free days and at most 45 chargeable days.
